spans.s: --an asura; friend of कंस. Appeared in the guise of a boa-constrictor in order to devour कृष्ण, his play- mates and cattle in बृन्दावन. Thinking it to be a part of the landscape of the बृन्दावन, कृष्ण's playmates and cattle entered his wide-open mouth. कृष्ण understood the situation, and after a little hesitation, he also went in and killed him by choking his throat. Agha, however, attained salvation. भा. X. १२. १३-38; १३. 4; १४. ६०.
(I)--a तीर्थ at the foot of the Vindhyas. Here दक्ष performed तपस् and praised Hari with the हम्सगुःय। भा.

(II)--a कौशिक and a sage.
1: Br. II. ३२. ११७; M. १४५. ११२.
Not to have matrimonial alliance with विश्वामित्र and others.
2: M. १९८. १२.
